fills.en: My new neighbor ___ from Taiwan, too.
fills.zh: 我的新鄰居也是從台灣來的。
fills.note: 主詞 My new neighbor 是單數第三人稱，be 動詞用 is。

fills.en: It's raining. Do you have an ___ I can use?
fills.zh: 在下雨。你有雨傘可以借我用嗎？
fills.note: 下雨天要用的是雨傘 umbrella。

fills.en: The number five bus ___ every twenty minutes.
fills.zh: 五號公車每二十分鐘來一班。
fills.note: 主詞是單數的 bus，講固定發生的事用現在式，動詞加 -s。

fills.en: These shoes are too ___. Do you have a bigger size?
fills.zh: 這雙鞋太緊了。有大一點的尺寸嗎？
fills.note: 要換大一號，表示鞋子太緊 tight。

fills.en: I ___ a package to my friend last week.
fills.zh: 我上星期寄了一個包裹給我朋友。
fills.note: last week 是過去的時間，用過去式 sent。

fills.en: Take one pill after each ___, with a glass of water.
fills.zh: 每餐飯後配一杯水吃一顆藥。
fills.note: after each meal 是「每餐飯後」。

fills.en: There ___ two chairs and a lamp in the room.
fills.zh: 房間裡有兩張椅子和一盞燈。
fills.note: 後面接的是複數的 two chairs，用 There are。

fills.en: I want to mail this postcard. How much is a ___?
fills.zh: 我想寄這張明信片。一張郵票多少錢？
fills.note: 寄明信片要買的是郵票 stamp。

fills.en: My friend ___ in the park every morning.
fills.zh: 我朋友每天早上都在公園跑步。
fills.note: every morning 是習慣，用現在式；主詞 My friend 是單數，動詞加 -s。

fills.en: Excuse me, can we see the ___? We want to order dessert.
fills.zh: 不好意思，可以看一下菜單嗎？我們想點甜點。
fills.note: 要點甜點，先看菜單 menu。

fills.en: We ___ a great time at the party last night.
fills.zh: 我們昨晚在派對上玩得很開心。
fills.note: last night 是過去的時間，用過去式 had。

fills.en: The museum is not far. You can ___ there in ten minutes.
fills.zh: 博物館不遠，你走路十分鐘就到了。
fills.note: 不遠、十分鐘就到，是走路 walk 過去。

question.en: How much are a muffin and an iced tea?
question.zh: 一個瑪芬加一杯冰紅茶多少錢？

question.en: How long does the bus take from the station to the library?
question.zh: 公車從車站開到圖書館要多久？

question.zh: 寄兩張明信片和一封信要多少錢？

passages.title: Room 302
lines: Hi, it's Amy from Room 302!
Saturday is my birthday, so I'm having a small party at home.
Please come at seven. We will have dinner an hour later, and the party will be over at about ten.
You don't need to bring a gift. If you want, bring something to drink.
See you on Saturday!

questions.en: What can the reader bring to the party?
questions.zh: 讀訊息的人可以帶什麼去派對？

passages.title: To All Neighbors
lines: Window cleaning: Tuesday and Wednesday, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Please close all your windows on these days.
Do not leave tables or lamps by the windows.
This week, please leave your trash in the cans at the back door, not the front door.
Need help? Call me at 555-0142.
Mr. Brown, Landlord

questions.en: What should people do on Tuesday?
questions.zh: 大家星期二應該做什麼？

questions.en: Where should people leave their trash this week?
questions.zh: 這星期垃圾要放在哪裡？

passages.title: Green Street Clinic
lines: To Ms. Lin,
You have an appointment with Dr. Park on Thursday at 10:30 a.m.
Please come fifteen minutes ahead of time to sign in, and bring your insurance card.
If you can't come, please call us by 5 p.m. on Wednesday.
Thank you.

questions.en: What time should Ms. Lin get there?
questions.zh: 林小姐應該幾點到診所？

questions.en: What should Ms. Lin do if she can't come?
questions.zh: 如果林小姐不能來，她應該怎麼做？
options: Call the doctor's office by Wednesday

passages.title: Sunday Market at Lake Park
lines: Every Sunday, 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
Fresh fruit, vegetables, bread, and cheese
Bring your own bag and get a free cookie!
No dogs, please.

questions.en: How can people get something for free?
questions.zh: 顧客要怎樣才能拿到免費的東西？

questions.en: What are people asked not to do?
questions.zh: 傳單請顧客不要做什麼？
